issue.title: Ensure that Kotlin subclass of QuarkusApplication works properly
2.15.2.Final breaks command mode with main class extends from QuarkusApplication in kotlin
issue.body:
### Describe the bug

Same error as in #30054 .

```kotlin
import io.quarkus.runtime.QuarkusApplication
import io.quarkus.runtime.annotations.QuarkusMain

@QuarkusMain
class MainCLI : QuarkusApplication {

    @Throws(Exception::class)
    override fun run(vararg args: String): Int {
        return 0
    }
}
```

```bash
...
[ERROR] Failed to execute goal io.quarkus.platform:quarkus-maven-plugin:2.15.2.Final:build (default) on project code-with-quarkus: Failed to build quarkus application: io.quarkus.builder.BuildException: Build failure: Build failed due to errors
[ERROR] 	[error]: Build step io.quarkus.deployment.steps.MainClassBuildStep#mainClassBuildStep threw an exception: java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: The supplied 'main-class' value of 'org.acme.MainCLIKt' does not correspond to either a fully qualified class name or a matching 'name' field of one of the '@QuarkusMain' annotations
...
```

### How to Reproduce?

[code-with-quarkus.zip](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/files/10350129/code-with-quarkus.zip)

`./mvnw clean install`

### Output of `java -version`

Java 17

### Quarkus version or git rev

2.15.2.Final

### Build tool (ie. output of `mvnw --version` or `gradlew --version`)

Maven
